chapters.title: What is aluminium?
chapters.text: A lightweight, non-magnetic metal — roughly a third of the weight of steel. A natural oxide layer gives it good corrosion resistance.

chapters.title: Forms we stock
chapters.text: Sheet, round bar, square bar, flat bar, tube, angle and treadplate. Bar is sold by weight per metre.

chapters.title: Reading the weight chart
chapters.text: 1" round bar weighs 1.414 kg/m. A 3mm sheet at 2m × 1m weighs about 16.3 kg.

checkpoints.question: Compared with steel, aluminium is roughly…
checkpoints.explanation: Aluminium is roughly a third of the weight of steel.

checkpoints.question: How is aluminium bar normally priced and measured?
checkpoints.explanation: Bar is sold by weight per metre (kg/m).

checkpoints.question: What is the weight of a 1" diameter aluminium round bar?

chapters.title: What makes it stainless?
chapters.text: Stainless steel contains at least about 10.5% chromium, which forms a protective layer that resists rust.

chapters.title: 304 vs 316
chapters.text: Grade 316 adds molybdenum for better resistance in marine and chemical environments. 304 is the general-purpose grade.

chapters.title: Reading the weight chart
chapters.text: Stainless is much denser than aluminium — a 25mm round bar weighs about 3.85 kg/m.

checkpoints.question: Which element gives stainless steel its corrosion resistance?
checkpoints.explanation: Chromium (min. ~10.5%) forms the passive protective layer.

checkpoints.question: A customer needs stainless for a boat fitting near sea water. Which grade suits best?
checkpoints.explanation: 316 contains molybdenum, improving resistance to chlorides.

checkpoints.question: Approximately how much does a 25mm stainless round bar weigh?

chapters.title: What is copper?
chapters.text: A heavy, highly conductive metal — second only to silver for electrical conductivity.

chapters.title: Common applications
chapters.text: Electrical busbars, earthing, heat exchangers and decorative work. Over time it develops a green patina.

chapters.title: Reading the weight chart
chapters.text: A 1" copper round bar weighs about 4.54 kg/m — over three times the aluminium equivalent.

checkpoints.question: Copper is best known for which property?
checkpoints.explanation: Copper is an excellent electrical (and thermal) conductor.

checkpoints.question: A customer asks for flat bar to make an electrical busbar. Which metal do you suggest first?
checkpoints.explanation: Copper flat bar is the standard busbar material.

checkpoints.question: Approximately how much does a 1" copper round bar weigh?

chapters.title: What is brass?
chapters.text: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc. It machines easily and has an attractive gold colour.

chapters.title: Free-machining brass
chapters.text: Free-machining grades (e.g. CZ121) contain a small amount of lead so chips break cleanly on the lathe.

chapters.title: Reading the weight chart
chapters.text: A 1" brass round bar weighs about 4.30 kg/m.

checkpoints.question: Brass is an alloy of copper and…
checkpoints.explanation: Brass = copper + zinc. (Bronze is copper + tin.)

checkpoints.question: Why do free-machining brass grades contain a little lead?
options: So chips break cleanly when machining
checkpoints.explanation: Lead acts as a chip breaker and improves machinability.

checkpoints.question: Approximately how much does a 1" brass round bar weigh?

chapters.title: What is phosphor bronze?
chapters.text: A copper–tin alloy with a small addition of phosphorus, giving strength and excellent wear resistance.

chapters.title: Where it's used
chapters.text: Bearings, bushes, gears and springs. Hollow bar lets customers machine bushes with less waste.

chapters.title: Reading the weight chart
chapters.text: A 1" phosphor bronze round bar weighs about 4.92 kg/m.

checkpoints.question: Phosphor bronze is mainly copper alloyed with…
checkpoints.explanation: Phosphor bronze = copper + tin + a small amount of phosphorus.

checkpoints.question: A customer is machining bushes. Which product helps reduce waste?
checkpoints.explanation: Hollow bar is already bored, so less material is machined away.

checkpoints.question: Approximately how much does a 1" phosphor bronze round bar weigh?
